notes: The corner tree now speaks Spanish - its rows were the last English left on a Spanish screen. The coaching sentences are built in Python and now go through the same translator the Corner Debrief used; the row text is assembled in the browser around the numbers, so those are keyed as the fragments the page actually renders (“typ +0.02 s”, “1.0 m tight”, “5 m earlier”, “+0.05 s lost on the straight, arriving 0.2 km/h slower at its brake point”). A new test demands a Spanish entry for every sentence template the corner tree can produce, and found four more that had none. Numbers, corner numbers and the circuit's own corner names stay as they are.
